firstPlayerRule: The person with the most unique eyes starts the game.
houseFallback: If the official instruction leaves an unresolved tie or cannot be applied, agree to choose randomly. This is this site's suggested house rule.
clarifications: The starter reads the first category card; everyone then writes answers at the same time.
The manual gives no method for deciding whose eyes are most unique.
